submission.reason: Exploration of data/explore.csv showed that no candidate exposure had a significant region-adjusted association with species_richness. Region alone explained the outcome (region means 46.5–53.6), while all ten exposures had |t| < 1 in OLS with region fixed effects (smallest p ≈ 0.34). I selected nitrate as the single best candidate because it had the largest standardized coefficient (0.25) and the only fully sign-consistent within-region correlation (positive in all 4 regions). The pre-registered confirmatory OLS of species_richness on nitrate plus site indicators on held-out data gave estimate 0.031 (SE 0.124), p = 0.80, n = 396 — not significant at alpha = 0.05. The hypothesis is therefore not confirmed; no exposure shows a direct effect after accounting for region.
